message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 in `npm test`.

The one failing test was `adds 20% VAT`. It asserted that `withVat(250)` returns 301, but 20% of 250 pence is 50, so the total is 300. The code in `src/vat.js` was already correct, so I changed the expected value in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left the source alone.

I haven't committed the change.
